chapter: Later years and the Texas scene
title: Third reel opening and chalk beer
summary: Allen opens the third reel on Aug 6, 1973 and asks about chalk, a homemade beer drunk in speakeasies.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs

blocks.x: Okay, it's going on the third real of Don Alba. It's August the 6th, 1973. Day after your birthday, huh? Day after your birthday, that's right. Let me see, we were talking back there about Buster Smith and all that. What about Chalk? Did I ever ask you about Chalk? Drinking Chalk? Did you ever hear of that? Chalk houses?

Well, you mean Chalk, you talking about Chalk the beer? Yeah. Oh yeah, I thought you were talking about somebody's name. That's the beer we used to drink, Chalk beer. That's a homemade beer, homebrew. It was in the speakeasers.
And they always call that Chalk? Chalk brew. I never had known them like much. They had speakeasers out in Texas.
Oh yeah, in those days, speakeasers.
